editorContent.label: Heading
editorContent.section: Common Questions
editorContent.value: Common Questions

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.section: Common Questions
editorContent.value: What equipment do I need?

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.section: Common Questions
editorContent.value: A smartphone, tablet, or computer with a camera and microphone. Most modern devices have everything you need built in.

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.section: Common Questions
editorContent.value: Is telehealth covered by insurance?

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.section: Common Questions
editorContent.value: Most insurance plans cover telehealth visits. Our patient advocates can verify your coverage before your appointment.

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.section: Common Questions
editorContent.value: What types of visits can be done via telehealth?

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.section: Common Questions
editorContent.value: Follow-up consultations, treatment discussions, symptom checks, lab result reviews, and survivorship visits are all well-suited for telehealth. Your care team will let you know if an in-person visit is needed.

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.section: Common Questions
editorContent.value: Is my telehealth visit private and secure?

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.section: Common Questions
editorContent.value: Yes. All telehealth visits use HIPAA-compliant, encrypted video connections to protect your privacy.
